# pypi-verify-action

> Reusable GitHub Action that verifies a freshly published PyPI release end-to-end: waits for index propagation, installs the exact published version into a clean venv, asserts the installed version, checks expected files under site-packages, and runs smoke commands. Fail-closed: a broken publish turns the workflow red.

- GitHub: https://github.com/holdout-labs/pypi-verify-action
- Usage: `uses: holdout-labs/pypi-verify-action@v1`
- Inputs: `package`, `version`, `python-version`, `timeout-seconds`, `poll-seconds`, `expected-files`, `smoke-commands`
- Full documentation: https://github.com/holdout-labs/pypi-verify-action/blob/main/README.md
